camel_example: aliyun alidns CreateCloudGtmInstanceConfig --region cn-hangzhou --ScheduleRrType A --ScheduleZoneName 'example.com' --InstanceId 'gtm-cn-jmp3qnw0003' --EnableStatus enable --ChargeType postpay --ScheduleHostname www --AcceptLanguage 'en-US' --ScheduleZoneMode custom --ClientToken '1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240022' --Ttl 30 --Remark test
description_en: Creates a configuration for a Global Traffic Manager (GTM) instance
kebab_example: aliyun alidns create-cloud-gtm-instance-config --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240022 --instance-id gtm-cn-jmp3qnw0003 --schedule-zone-mode custom --schedule-zone-name example.com --schedule-hostname www --schedule-rr-type A --ttl 30 --remark test --enable-status enable --charge-type postpay --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCloudGtmInstanceConfig

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese.

- en-US: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

- zh-CN：中文。

- en-US：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can specify a custom value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain up to 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。该参数值可自定义，但是要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the GTM 3.0 instance
parameters.help_zh: 全局流量管理3.0实例ID，唯一标识产品实例
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The configuration mode for the access domain name:

- sys\_assign: The system assigns a domain name. This mode is no longer supported.

- custom: Custom mode. Select a domain name under the account that owns the instance and enter a host record to generate the access domain name
parameters.help_zh:
接入域名配置模式：

- sys_assign：系统分配（此模式已不支持）

- custom：自定义，用户需选择实例所在账号下的域名进行关联，并输入主机记录以生成接入域名
parameters.name: schedule_zone_mode

parameters.help_en: The zone name, which is the parent zone of the GTM access domain name. This is typically a domain name hosted in the Alibaba Cloud DNS console under the account that owns the GTM instance. Primary domains and subdomains are supported
parameters.help_zh: zone名称，即GTM接入域名的父Zone。一般为GTM实例所在账号下，在云解析DNS控制台的托管域名，支持主域和子域
parameters.name: schedule_zone_name

parameters.help_en: The host record of the GTM access domain name
parameters.name: schedule_hostname

parameters.help_en:
The DNS record type of the access domain name:

- A: IPv4 address

- AAAA: IPv6 address

- CNAME: Canonical name
parameters.help_zh:
接入域名的解析记录类型：

- A：IPv4地址

- AAAA：IPv6地址

- CNAME：域名
parameters.name: schedule_rr_type

parameters.help_en: The global Time to Live (TTL) in seconds. This is the TTL for the access domain name that resolves to an address in an address pool. This value affects how long the DNS record is cached on a carrier's local DNS server. You can specify a custom TTL
parameters.help_zh: 全局TTL，单位是秒。接入域名解析到地址池中地址的TTL值，影响解析记录在运营商LocalDNS中的缓存时间，支持自定义TTL值
parameters.name: ttl

parameters.help_en:
The status of the domain name instance:

- enable: Enabled. The intelligent scheduling policy of the GTM instance is active.

- disable: Disabled. The intelligent scheduling policy of the GTM instance is unavailable
parameters.help_zh:
域名实例的启用状态：

- enable：启用状态，GTM实例智能调度策略生效；

- disable：禁用状态，GTM实例智能调度策略不可用；
parameters.name: enable_status

parameters.help_en:
The billing method for the instance configuration:

- prepay: Subscription. This is the default value.

- postpay: Pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
实例配置的付费类型：

- 预付费：prepay (传入空值默认是prepay)

- 后付费：postpay
parameters.name: charge_type
